objective: Enforce archive entry, uncompressed-size and compression-ratio limits before CRC reads or extraction.
scenario: An adapter ZIP advertises a file exceeding the per-member uncompressed limit or an excessive compression ratio. The validator must reject it from central-directory metadata before decompression.
expected_behaviors: Entry-count, member-size, total-size and compression-ratio limits are checked during preflight.
Oversized entries are rejected before archive.testzip() or extraction reads them.
The installation destination remains empty after rejection.
prohibited_behaviors: Run CRC/decompression across an unbounded archive before size checks.
Begin writing files before all archive entries pass preflight.
